record.name: Vertex 0: FDP-1 reference
record.definition: FDP-1 exactly as on main: pulsed magnetised D-3He point burn, three-loop Fiji-amplified magnetic nozzle, shadow shield, 600 K warm loop. Optimistic scenario tier.
record.fictional: Canon Fiji lattice (VTX-02A); the calculator gives it no numeric credit.

record.name: Vertex 1: advanced engineering, no new fictional effect
record.definition: V0 plus Level A/B engineering targets: split warm loop averaging 700 K, house load halved, driver galleries inside the hull cone. No added fictional property, no new collimation credit.
record.fictional: Canon Fiji lattice only, unchanged from V0.

changes.rationale: Cores at about 600 K (Curie limits), power conversion at about 773 K (SiC ICs shown for a year): an area-weighted warm loop near 700 K.
Target factory and controls at 0.05 % of fusion. The 0.1 % baseline is itself unsourced; this is a requirement, not a result.
Galleries folded inside the 7.9 deg equipment-module cone; the calculator re-sizes the shield. Routing inside the hull is unchecked.
The three canon H2 vessels are idle in FDP-1; removing them is a canon change (decision D-04). convergence.py also reports V1 with them kept.

record.name: Vertex 2: Fiji-integrated, canon-bounded
record.definition: V1 plus the strongest physically defensible targets: warm loop at 800 K, advanced tungsten armour at half areal mass. Fiji keeps exactly its canon card (VTX-02A); no extra Fiji property is assumed.
record.fictional: Canon Fiji lattice; the gap to any benchmark V2 misses is reported as extra capability that would be needed, not assumed.

changes.rationale: All machinery heat at 800 K: needs MW-class power electronics at 800 K and induction cores near their FINEMET limit (823-843 K).
Advanced W armour (MAT-W-ADV01) holding the allowed fluence at half the areal mass.

plume_strike_sweep.label: plume-to-hardware share of the nozzle loss (VTX-03 band)

house_sweep.label: house load as a fraction of fusion (VTX-07C, VTX-01C)

liner_study.note: Fixed fuel rhoR, tamper mu kg per kg fuel, rest optimistic. ve = sqrt(2 eta_jet b eps / (1 + mu)). Tamper-enhanced burnup (inertial confinement by the tamper) is not modelled: b is held at the untampered value, so a burnup gain is UNKNOWN.

ve_sweep.note: Rocket equation on the whole four-burn delta-v; tanks, radiators and drive that scale with propellant are not included, so the real penalty is larger. Use of the low gear for short phases is a mission question (decision D-04).
